title: kit.governance.v1
description: governance.json at a repository root: the ONE declared source of the review requirements of the generated default-branch ruleset (.github/rulesets/default-branch.json, `kit agent-guard sync`; `sync --check` and `github verify` compare against it). Absent, the kit's defaults hold (the registry's separation.requiredApprovals approvals, code-owner review and last-push approval). A solo-owner project, whose author cannot approve their own pull request, declares 0 approvals with the independent-review marker and the merge gate in their place (docs/RELEASE.md): `required` 0, `code_owner_review` false, `last_push_approval` false, `independent_review_marker` true. A ruleset can never carry fewer requirements than this file states, and this file can never declare no human approval AND no independent review.

required.description: required_approving_review_count of the ruleset's pull_request rule (the author never counts).

code_owner_review.description: require_code_owner_review: a CODEOWNERS owner must approve. Needs at least one approval (unsatisfiable by a solo owner).

last_push_approval.description: require_last_push_approval: the most recent push must be approved by someone other than its pusher. Needs at least one approval.

independent_review_marker.description: An independent review of the head commit is recorded as a marker the merge gate reads before a merge (the push gate refuses a branch without a clean independent review). Required when no human approval is.
